title: Final Status: UAS-11 Incident Closed

fields.to: Incident Commander (IC), Aviation Safety Officer (ASO), Security / CCSO Liaison (Sec), Client Liaison (SPO), Communications Lead (PIO)
fields.subject: Final Status: UAS-11 Incident Closed — Restoration Phase Complete
fields.body:
All roles,

This is the final status update for the UAS-11 incident. The aircraft remains in manual/attitude mode on the meadow, with GCS-01 and the 915 MHz radio state preserved. The fleet of that type is grounded per HUOG-ISP Section 9.1. The baseline image (03.2026-B) has been verified on GCS-04. The managed SOC has confirmed forensic imaging and log integrity. The FSDO and client have been formally notified per HUOG-ISP Section 9.3 and HUOG-ERP Section 11.4. The incident log at \HUOG-NAS01\ops\incident-log\2026-09-01\UAS-11\ has been closed.

All roles are to prepare for the hot wash as per HUOG-ERP Section 11.4. The hot wash will begin in one hour. The hazard log will be updated with three things that went well and three to fix.

This incident is now closed.
fields.signatureBlock:
Marguerite Ostrowski
General Manager
Harwick UAS Operations Group

instructorNote: This inject closes the incident and triggers the hot wash. The IC must confirm log closure and readiness for the hot wash.
